entries.title: Psalms 94:1
segments: O Jehovah, thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.

entries.title: Psalms 94:2
segments: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render to the proud [their] desert.

entries.title: Psalms 94:3
segments: Jehovah, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked triumph?

entries.title: Psalms 94:4
segments: They prate, they speak arrogantly: All the workers of iniquity boast themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 94:5
segments: They break in pieces thy people, O Jehovah, And afflict thy heritage.

entries.title: Psalms 94:6
segments: They slay the widow and the sojourner, And murder the fatherless.

entries.title: Psalms 94:7
segments: And they say,  Jehovah will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob consider.

entries.title: Psalms 94:8
segments: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye be wise?

entries.title: Psalms 94:9
segments: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?

entries.title: Psalms 94:10
segments: He that  chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct, [Even] he that teacheth man knowledge?

entries.title: Psalms 94:11
segments: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man,  That they are  vanity.

entries.title: Psalms 94:12
segments: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jehovah, And teachest out of thy law;

entries.title: Psalms 94:13
segments: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 94:14
segments: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, Neither will he forsake his inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 94:15
segments: For judgment shall return unto righteousness; And all the upright in heart shall follow it.

entries.title: Psalms 94:16
segments: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

entries.title: Psalms 94:17
segments: Unless Jehovah had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.

entries.title: Psalms 94:18
segments: When I said, My foot slippeth; Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, held me up.

entries.title: Psalms 94:19
segments: In the multitude of my  thoughts within me Thy comforts delight my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 94:20
segments: Shall the  throne of wickedness have fellowship with thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?

entries.title: Psalms 94:21
segments: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn the innocent blood.

entries.title: Psalms 94:22
segments: But Jehovah hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 94:23
segments: And he hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own wickedness; Jehovah our God will cut them off.
